// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// A child relation name outside the one permitted position. Ordering schools by
// how much their children have posted is a profile of those children by another
// name (rule 11, amendment C3).
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function busiest() {
  return db.class.count({ orderBy: { students: { _count: "desc" } } });
}
